{{Top|leg}}
An '''electromagnetic discharge filter''' was a device used on [[Starship/Legends|starships]] which would remove static from a [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] screen. A [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] would use glide switches to reduce the amount of static on the screen.

Some luxurious starships, such as [[Lalu Morwan]]'s [[Batag Skiff]], had automatic filters.<ref name="Tempest">''[[Legacy of the Force: Tempest]]''</ref>
